title: Review: jmap-client crate
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — ClientError semver trap and false-oracle WS tests are real issues; SSE/blob streaming design is sound; no security holes found
Confidence: 10% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: OOM window in streaming (tradeoff well-understood, reqwest API limits options). Uncertainty driven by: cannot test behavior at exact size boundaries without a mock server. Would raise confidence if: streaming size-cap tests with partial-read mock were added.
Idiom rating: CLEAN — no unsafe, no Box<dyn Error> in API, no gratuitous clones in hot paths, no unwrap without justification, proper non_exhaustive on public protocol types. Only gaps: ClientError lacks #[non_exhaustive] (filed) and WS tests don't verify WsRequestFrame serde (filed).
Rust idiom confidence: 5% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: none — the two filed issues are clear. Uncertainty driven by: cannot statically verify WsRequestFrame serde output without running it.
